// Use a fixed well-known UUID for the singleton settings row const SETTINGS_ID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"; await sql` INSERT INTO notification_settings ( id, notification_subject_template, notification_body_template, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, timezone, updated_at ) VALUES ( ${SETTINGS_ID}, '{{product_name}} is back in stock!', '

Great news! {{item_detail}} is back in stock.

', ${safeStart}, ${safeEnd}, ${safeTz}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET quiet_hours_start = EXCLUDED.quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end = EXCLUDED.quiet_hours_end, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, updated_at = now() `;
